about_page.title: About the Company
about_page.description: NAS Crystal — your reliable partner in the world of premium rhinestones and crystals
text: We specialize in supplying high-quality decorative crystals and rhinestones for professionals in the fashion, dance sport, and handicraft industries.
Our team carefully selects every batch, guaranteeing flawless cutting quality, accurate color rendering, and consistent sizing.
We cooperate with leading factories in Austria and Asia, offering an optimal balance of quality and price for our clients.
